claim_ceiling: Dense embeddings recover citation heritage at scale (AUC 0.79-0.85) but FAIL jurist gate on language dominance; linear hybrids PASS adversarial at optimal weight (w=0.3-0.4) but remain BELOW TF-IDF baseline (JP 0.66-0.67 vs 0.78-0.79). TF-IDF citation/outcome hybrids remain production default (JP 0.73-0.79). No single representation dominates all three adversarial metrics (LangDom, JP, CiteIndep) at any scale. evidence_summary: Verified 22 evidence_refs across 5 scales (3yr/15yr/19yr/20yr/22yr). Key verified: (1) TF-IDF 174k formal suite: 6/6 representations PASS both adversarial gates (production default JP=0.7345, LangDom=0.4773). (2) Dense blocker: 144,443/173,963 decisions (83%), 2022-2026 missing, no parquet, no bge_<->bger_ mapping. (3) Center_projected FAILS jurist gate at ALL scales (22yr JP=0.4265, 20yr JP=0.0475 catastrophic, 19yr JP=0.3685, 15yr JP=0.288, 3yr JP=0.39-0.42). (4) Linear combos: 19yr optimal w=0.3 (JP=0.6465), 22yr optimal w=0.4 cited / w=0.3 hybrid (JP=0.6725/0.6605) — both PASS but below TF-IDF baseline. (5) Section cross-lingual: sachverhalt superior (gap 0.187 vs 0.452 at cp64). (6) Two-mode tradeoff reproduced: Citation/Outcome JP~0.78 vs Semantic JP~0.05-0.43 vs Hybrid JP~0.66. (7) v8 holdout: minimal leakage (LangDom +0.005, JP -0.015 to -0.034). (8) Citation heritage: TF-IDF citation-based AUC 0.71-0.74 PASS; dense embeddings AUC 0.79-0.85 PASS (BETTER). (9) Boilerplate resistance negative all reps (score ~-0.84). (10) Orchestration failure confirmed: factory direction v29 claimed corpus mount path resolved but /tmp/lex_accepted/core/ does not exist. All negative/null results honestly represented.
